protocol: Post-all-agents-action strict physical score. Each task equal weight, not pooled goals. Only genuinely terminated episodes carried forward. No smoothing, interior interpolation, cumulative maximum, filtering of failed runs, or extrapolation from final success rates.
scope: Same frozen updater/access rules/planner/per-call caps, different readout. Realized token use and closed-loop trajectories need not match. NL is a matched deterministic readout of revisable state, not an independent learned memory system. This is the full first-seed block; later incomplete/paused seeds are not pooled.
interpretation: The curves cross. Higher SSC terminal completion does not establish earlier completion overall or a monotonically widening advantage. No significance claim.
